settlement_mismatch_filter.after_start: records settle 'confirmed' only on a binary venue result; walkover / cancellation / 50-50 / fair-price settlements and operator-reported retirements are excluded
settlement_mismatch_filter.at_admission: venue rules must state retirement -> advancing player and walkover -> fair price / 50-50; ITF refused; silence refused

bookmaker_basis.note: Bookmaker match-winner odds are quoted on a 'match completed' basis: walkovers void the bet and most books (Pinnacle among them) void on retirement. Venue contracts pay the advancing player on retirement and settle walkovers at a fair price (Kalshi) or 50-50 (Polymarket). The outside line is therefore P(win | completed); the venue mid prices P(advances). The difference is bounded by the retirement/withdrawal rate and is NOT modelled here.
